package lessonexample

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

const maxExampleOrder = 32767

var exampleSlugPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`)

// ReplaceLessonExamples atomically reconciles all examples owned by one lesson.
type ReplaceLessonExamples struct {
	Lessons  repository.LessonRepository
	Examples repository.LessonExampleRepository
	I18n     repository.I18nRepository
	Tx       repository.TransactionManager
}

func (uc ReplaceLessonExamples) Handle(ctx context.Context, lessonID string, examples []domain.LessonExample) error {
	lessonID, err := normalizeID(lessonID)
	if err != nil || uc.Lessons == nil || uc.Examples == nil || uc.I18n == nil {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	normalized, err := normalizeExamples(lessonID, examples)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	run := func(fn func(context.Context) error) error {
		if uc.Tx != nil {
			return uc.Tx.WithTx(ctx, fn)
		}
		return fn(ctx)
	}
	return run(func(ctx context.Context) error {
		if _, err := uc.Lessons.Get(ctx, lessonID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := validateTranslationLanguages(ctx, uc.I18n, normalized); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return uc.Examples.ReplaceByLesson(ctx, lessonID, normalized)
	})
}

// ListLessonExamples returns examples for one lesson.
type ListLessonExamples struct {
	Lessons  repository.LessonRepository
	Examples repository.LessonExampleRepository
}

func (uc ListLessonExamples) Handle(ctx context.Context, lessonID string, activeOnly bool) ([]domain.LessonExample, error) {
	lessonID, err := normalizeID(lessonID)
	if err != nil || uc.Lessons == nil || uc.Examples == nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	lesson, err := uc.Lessons.Get(ctx, lessonID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if activeOnly && lesson.Status != domain.LessonStatusActive {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return uc.Examples.ListByLesson(ctx, lessonID, activeOnly)
}

// DeleteLessonExample removes one example by ID.
type DeleteLessonExample struct {
	Examples repository.LessonExampleRepository
}

func (uc DeleteLessonExample) Handle(ctx context.Context, exampleID string) error {
	exampleID, err := normalizeID(exampleID)
	if err != nil || uc.Examples == nil {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return uc.Examples.Delete(ctx, exampleID)
}

func normalizeExamples(lessonID string, examples []domain.LessonExample) ([]domain.LessonExample, error) {
	result := make([]domain.LessonExample, 0, len(examples))
	sourceKeys := make(map[string]struct{}, len(examples))
	orders := make(map[int]struct{}, len(examples))
	for _, example := range examples {
		if example.ID == "" {
			example.ID = uuid.NewString()
		} else {
			var err error
			example.ID, err = normalizeID(example.ID)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, domain.ErrValidation
			}
		}
		var err error
		example.SourceKey, err = domain.NormalizeContentSourceKey(example.SourceKey)
		if err != nil || example.SourceKey == "" {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if _, exists := sourceKeys[example.SourceKey]; exists {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: duplicate lesson example source_key", domain.ErrConflict)
		}
		sourceKeys[example.SourceKey] = struct{}{}
		if example.Order < 1 || example.Order > maxExampleOrder {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if _, exists := orders[example.Order]; exists {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: duplicate lesson example order", domain.ErrConflict)
		}
		orders[example.Order] = struct{}{}
		if example.Status != domain.LessonExampleStatusInactive && example.Status != domain.LessonExampleStatusActive {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		example.Mode = strings.TrimSpace(example.Mode)
		if len(example.Mode) > 128 || !exampleSlugPattern.MatchString(example.Mode) {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		example.Stacks, err = normalizeSlugs(example.Stacks, true)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		example.TargetConcepts, err = normalizeSlugs(example.TargetConcepts, true)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if example.PrimaryStack != nil {
			primary := strings.TrimSpace(*example.PrimaryStack)
			if !exampleSlugPattern.MatchString(primary) || !contains(example.Stacks, primary) {
				return nil, domain.ErrValidation
			}
			example.PrimaryStack = &primary
		}
		example.Translations, err = normalizeTranslations(example.ID, example.Translations)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		example.LessonID = lessonID
		result = append(result, example)
	}
	return result, nil
}

func normalizeTranslations(exampleID string, translations []domain.LessonExampleI18n) ([]domain.LessonExampleI18n, error) {
	if len(translations) < 2 {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	result := make([]domain.LessonExampleI18n, 0, len(translations))
	ids := make(map[int]struct{}, len(translations))
	for _, translation := range translations {
		if translation.I18nID <= 0 {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if _, exists := ids[translation.I18nID]; exists {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		ids[translation.I18nID] = struct{}{}
		if strings.TrimSpace(translation.Title) == "" || utf8.RuneCountInString(translation.Title) > 255 || strings.TrimSpace(translation.Description) == "" {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		translation.ExampleID = exampleID
		result = append(result, translation)
	}
	return result, nil
}

func validateTranslationLanguages(ctx context.Context, i18n repository.I18nRepository, examples []domain.LessonExample) error {
	cache := make(map[int]string)
	for _, example := range examples {
		languages := make(map[string]struct{}, len(example.Translations))
		for _, translation := range example.Translations {
			language, ok := cache[translation.I18nID]
			if !ok {
				entry, err := i18n.GetByID(ctx, translation.I18nID)
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				language = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(entry.Language))
				cache[translation.I18nID] = language
			}
			languages[language] = struct{}{}
		}
		if _, ok := languages["ru"]; !ok {
			return domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if _, ok := languages["en"]; !ok {
			return domain.ErrValidation
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func normalizeSlugs(values []string, required bool) ([]string, error) {
	if required && len(values) == 0 {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	result := make([]string, 0, len(values))
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
	for _, value := range values {
		value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
		if len(value) > 128 || !exampleSlugPattern.MatchString(value) {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if _, exists := seen[value]; exists {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		seen[value] = struct{}{}
		result = append(result, value)
	}
	return result, nil
}

func normalizeID(value string) (string, error) {
	value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(value); err != nil {
		return "", domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return value, nil
}

func contains(values []string, target string) bool {
	for _, value := range values {
		if value == target {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
